purpose: Ranked reference examples for evaluating artist similarity, not exhaustive ground truth.
ranking: Five ordered matches per reference artist, with rank 1 representing the strongest perceived musical similarity. Related solo projects and groups are eligible.

listener.label: Listener
listener.source: Personal listening experience and musical judgment
listener.notes: Selected and ordered by the listener. Subjective, revisable, and not an exhaustive list of relevant matches.

llm.label: Independent LLM
llm.source: LLM-generated ranked judgments supplied by the listener
llm.notes: Includes a brief justification per match. Model identity, research sources, and compliance with the independence instructions were not supplied or independently verified; judgments remain subjective and revisable.
